This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Rix Road" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|red]] skin and series of head tendrils that dangled from the tops of their heads.<ref name="Rix Road" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[5 BBY]], a member of this species was a resident of [[Ferrix City]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], participating in the [[Ferrix Riot|riot]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] on [[Rix Road]].<ref name="Rix Road" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Head-Tendrils-Species-BTS.png|thumb|right|250px|Creation of this species behind-the-scenes]]
This species first appeared in the [[Rix Road (episode)|twelfth episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Benjamin Caron]].<ref name="Rix Road" />
